content.comment_body: I want to get my [product_name] to display on AWS. I have set up AWS, and everything was working fine—instances and environments showed healthy status. As soon as I deployed my [product_name] Web Editor to AWS, my website (using Elastic Beanstalk) encountered a 502 bad gateway error. I've tried numerous solutions but haven't resolved it. Can someone provide assistance?

Depending on your [product_name] model, you may be limited to only AWS or Web-server functionality. Check the manual for your specific [product_name] to confirm if it supports only one feature at a time.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing a major problem where deploying the [product_name] Web Editor to AWS results in a 502 bad gateway error, disrupting their website. There is confusion about hardware capabilities and integration between [product_name], its Web Editor, and AWS. Another user highlights a possible hardware restriction, where only one function—either AWS integration or Web-server access—may be supported at once, indicating a need for clearer documentation or design clarification.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates smooth integration between the [product_name] Web Editor and AWS, expecting website stability and uninterrupted access after deployment.
